interval_years.quote: All licensees shall renew their licenses on or before January 1 of every second year

available.quote: An applicant for expedited licensure by reciprocity shall meet the qualifications set forth in Section 61-8-8 NMSA 1978

requirements.value: Must have been licensed by national examination in another jurisdiction, practiced podiatry for at least three consecutive years immediately preceding the application, and be in good standing with the other licensing jurisdiction.
requirements.quote: furnish proof satisfactory to the board of having been licensed by national examination in another licensing jurisdiction

regulatory_model.quote: Unless licensed as a podiatric physician pursuant to the provisions of the Podiatry Act or exempted from that act pursuant to Section 61-8-4 NMSA 1978, no person shall practice podiatry.

title_protection.quote: advertising or using any designation, diploma or certificate tending to imply that one is a practitioner of podiatry, including the use of the words "chiropodist", "podiatrist", "podiatric physician" ... unless one holds a license or is exempted under the provisions of the Podiatry Act

scope_protection.quote: practicing or attempting to practice podiatry without a current valid license issued by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a criminal conviction related to the profession of podiatry
